The Department of Veteran Affairs, Oscar G. Johnson VA Medical Center: 325 East H Street Iron Mountain, MI 49801-4760 has the need or requirement for a Fluent Pro System – Brand name or Equal. The Government is requesting that Other Than Small Businesses and Small Businesses, including VIP-Verified VOSB or SDVOSB sources respond if it can provide the requested information. For more detailed information, please see the attached document file called: P02_ Market Research_Sources Sought Notice on Fluent Pro System – Brand name or Equal_Responses due NLT 05.06.2026, 3PM CST.

If you have any questions, or concerns, please contact the Contracting POC at: arneil.genus@va.gov
